place: Chidiya Tapu Sunset Point and Bird Sanctuary
text: Chidiya Tapu Sunset Point and Bird Sanctuary is a celebrated destination in Port Blair, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, renowned for its nature, wildlife, viewpoints. Located in the historic and scenic region of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, it holds deep cultural, geographical, and architectural significance. Visitors explore this site to experience the authentic traditions, local atmosphere, and scenic beauty of Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The best time to plan a visit is generally October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks). Regional cuisines and seasonal festivals enrich the journey.
